recognize_zh: H&E 切片中是一片單調、中等大小、核圓且有數個小核仁的淋巴樣細胞，其中散在周圍有透亮空隙、吞噬凋亡碎片的巨噬細胞（A，starry sky）與多個有絲分裂像（B），符合 Burkitt 淋巴瘤/白血病。
features: Diffuse sheet of monotonous medium-sized cells, with nuclei roughly the size of a histiocyte nucleus
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and several small nucleoli
Scant amphophilic cytoplasm with cells appearing cohesive or squared-off against each other
Tingible-body macrophages with clear surrounding halo producing a starry-sky pattern (arrow A)
Frequent mitotic figures (arrows B) indicating a very high proliferative rate
describe_en: Section stained with H&E shows effacement by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, multiple small nucleoli, and scant amphophilic cytoplasm. Interspersed tingible-body macrophages with clear halos impart a starry-sky appearance, and mitotic figures are readily identified. No significant large-cell pleomorphism is seen. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia; confirmation with CD10, BCL6, near-100% Ki-67, negative BCL2 and TdT, and MYC rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger (nuclei exceeding a histiocyte nucleus) and more pleomorphic, with a lower and more variable Ki-67 and usually BCL2 expression.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma can show starry-sky Burkitt-like morphology and is separated by BCL2 rearrangement and strong BCL2 staining.
Lymphoblasts have finer, more dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli and are TdT positive, whereas Burkitt cells are TdT negative with multiple small nucleoli.
Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma is CD5 and cyclin D1 positive with t(11;14) and typically lacks CD10.
